title: Bind stateless signed extended exchange into the admitted F-PM14 transactional drainage-response runtime
purpose: Qualify that the Q4A stateless extended drainage/infiltration law can be selected as a normal F-PM14 drainage-response variant and inherits the existing trial, rollback, exactly-once mass booking and no-extra-state semantics.

frozen_design.interval_control: explicit resolved external surface-water head, distinct from the legacy generic drain_head control
frozen_design.mass_booking: unchanged existing F-PM14 trial ledger; response binding itself must keep transfer_booked_here=false
frozen_design.surface_water_storage_owner: external Ribasim/coupler context only; no SWST/WLS state added to SWAP runtime

runtime_cases.expected: one accepted transaction, revision 0->1, hard mass closure, extended drainage booked once as external out
one accepted transaction, revision 0->1, hard mass closure, extended infiltration booked once as external in
no commit, revision and committed hydraulic state bit-identical to origin

binding_checks: configuration rejects extended variant unless exactly one finite resolved external surface-water head is supplied
positive and negative signed values propagate through per-level bottom-lumped qdra without clipping
existing aggregate remains derived view only and is not booked as a second transfer
O0 and O2 outputs are identical
no new SAVE/process state or surface-water storage is introduced
nonclaims: Q4B does not make Ribasim availability part of the SWAP constitutive law.
Q4B does not accept a Ribasim-limited negative request by clipping an already accepted SWAP trial; Q3A recomposition semantics remain authoritative.
Q4B does not provide production admission or whole surfacewater.f90 retirement authority.
